hero.statement: I build cinematic, scroll-driven web experiences: 3D, motion and interfaces that feel alive.
hero.availability: Open to full-time roles, in France or remote.

about.intro: I'm Mathis, a front-end developer based near Paris. I spent two years at Thales building interfaces for the French Navy, then went freelance to make websites that move: scroll-driven 3D, motion, and type that reacts to you.

experience.detail: React and Next.js interfaces in TypeScript, GSAP animation, Supabase and Prisma, deployed on Vercel.

Apprenticeship in a team of ten working in Scrum. Configuration and monitoring of the communication system of French Navy frigates: interactive diagrams of onboard equipment, configuration screens and supervision dashboards, in Angular and Java.
An interface to configure and deploy the simulation environment.
Six months fixing bugs and optimising the front end of two internal Angular applications.
Three months on a user profile administration site in C# and ASP.NET.

education.role: Master's in Web Engineering and Digital Innovation, IIM
Bachelor's in Web and Mobile Development, IIM
education.detail: Including a semester abroad at Dorset College, Dublin.

items.title: Motion with a reason
items.description: Animation should explain something: where you are, what changed, what to look at next. If it only decorates, it goes.

items.title: Built like production software
items.description: Two years in an enterprise team taught me code review, continuous integration and tickets that actually get closed. Creative work gets the same discipline.

items.title: Learning by building
items.description: Personal projects are where I try what I haven't used yet. Finishing them is how I learn the most.

about.toolbox: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, GSAP, Framer Motion, Three.js, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Prisma, Java, Python, Figma, Git, Jenkins, Jira, Robot Framework.
offScreen: Former competitive Rocket League player, top 100 worldwide in 3v3.
Travelled to Iceland, Thailand, Vietnam, Tunisia, Greece, the United States and Ireland.
